title: Rogers-Ramanujan and Schur partition identities in Lean

currentState.focus: Exchange bijection between gap-only and mod-only partitions

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Built formal reduction framework. Schur axiom <=> gap count = GF coeff <=> |GapOnly|=|ModOnly| (exchange bijection). Canonical split defined with 11 properties proved. Collision analysis shows context-dependent splitting needed. 0 sorries, 3 axioms, ~3070 lines.

insights: All 3 axioms encode deep partition identities (RR1, RR2, Schur)
Noncomputable definitions prevent native_decide verification
Proving any axiom requires 300-500+ lines of GF proof per identity
Part XXVI (part count bounds) broke due to Mathlib API changes
Subset sum recursion: inserting element k splits subsets into containing-k and not-containing-k families
GF coefficient theorem connects algebraic (PowerSeries) to combinatorial (subsetsWithSum) counting
partitionOfSubset converts finsets to Nat.Partition, bridging subset and partition formulations
All three identities (RR1, RR2, Schur corrected) computationally verified through n=15
Proved distinctPartGF_coeff by Finset.induction: key insight is to revert n before induction so IH works for all indices. Uses PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul for k≤n case and X_pow_dvd_iff for n<k case.
Proved schurMod_to_subset: convert Nodup multiset to Finset via toFinset, use Multiset.dedup_eq_self for sum equality.
PowerSeries.coeff API change: R is now implicit (use coeff (R := ℤ) n, not coeff ℤ n).
SchurMod ↔ subsetsWithSum bijection via Finset.card_bij: forward p↦parts.toFinset, inverse via partitionOfSubset
RR1/RR2 mod sides allow repeated parts (no Nodup) → distinctPartGF approach only works for Schur, not RR
schurMod_card_eq_gf_coeff chains: bijection → distinctPartGF_coeff → GF definition equality
Bounded counts schurGapBounded(m,n) ≠ schurModBounded(m,n) for m < n — the identity is genuinely global
Gap-side recurrence uses gap(m) offset: G(m,n)=G(m-1,n)+G(m-gap,n-m). Mod-side uses M(m,n)=M(m-1,n)+M(m-1,n-m). Different recurrences → cannot prove by matching.
Three viable proof strategies remain: (a) direct bijection, (b) GF identity at power series level, (c) clever variable substitution

Session 5 assessment: 3 axioms remain (RR1, RR2, Schur). All verified computationally to n=15. Proving symbolically requires either bijective proof (Bressoud-Zeilberger style) or GF identity approach. The GF infrastructure (partGF, geomSeries, convolution) is mature but connecting it to the specific partition sets needs additional work.
Exchange reduction: Schur identity <=> |GapOnly| = |ModOnly| where GapOnly = gap-valid with div3-part, ModOnly = mod-valid with gap-violation
Canonical split of c=0 mod 3: splitHi=(c+2)/2, splitLo=c-splitHi. Gap <= 2 (violates Schur >=3). Split parts not 0 mod 3.
Collision issue: canonical split(9)=(5,4) collides with existing part 4 in {9,4,1}. Context-dependent split needed for general case.
mathlibGaps: No bijective proof machinery for partition identities
